definition: A contemplative recollection built around upasama-side peace or quieting language, often linked to nibbāna.
notes: Use this record only when a source explicitly names recollection of peace. The compound inherits the distinction between upasama and santi and should not be flattened into mere relaxation-language. AN 11.12 contains six other recollections, not this compound; AN 1.296-305 supplies the direct early-text list source.

example_phrases.notes: The final member of the ten recollections in the AN 1.296-305 list.

version_notes: Replaced the false AN 11.12 citation after direct source inspection. That discourse names recollections of the Buddha, Dhamma, Sangha, conduct, generosity, and devas, but not upasamanussati. AN 1.296-305 directly names upasamanussati in its ten-recollection list.
